name: Idiosyncratic short-crowding: deep-negative funding gated by a CALM macro tape (NOT funding-alone)
rationale: Thesis: deep-negative funding squeezes resolve UP only when the crypto fear is IDIOSYNCRATIC, not part of a systemic macro rout (when the whole risk complex is in free-fall, crowded shorts are correct and the squeeze fails). Arm the positioning gate only on a calm tape. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.006,-0.0006] (crowded shorts) AND vix_level < a fitted panic ceiling AND macro_regime > a risk-off floor (composite not deeply risk-off). vix_level and macro_regime are BOUNDED so lt/gt on level is valid. DISCONFIRMER: must beat deep-funding ALONE — if lone positioning matches net Sharpe, the calm-tape arming gate (the actual claim) is worthless and this is just niche-#4 spec-1 rebuilt. funding_feature null — positioning, not carry. Exit on funding normalizing up.
catalyst: deep-negative funding squeeze while VIX and the macro regime are calm (crypto-local stress)
